name: General category for employers for whom the NSSO does not collect any special contribution for a social fund and who do not fall into any other specific category (see also category 011).

Specific category for employers liable for a special contribution to the 'Fund for the training of workers of the Joint Auxiliary Committee for Workers' (PC no. 100) and no special contribution for employees (since 01/07/2014, this includes casino activities; technical control and conformity assessment).

Employers for whom, under the law of 22 February 1998, the National Social Security Office ensures the collection and recovery of contributions which until 30/09/1998 were collected by the Miners' Pension Fund.
Intermediaries in banking and investment services, registered with the FSMA.

Employers under the Joint Committee for Service and Support to Businesses and Self-employed (PC 335) who are liable for an employer contribution to the 'Fund for the training of workers under the competence of the Joint Committee for Service and Support to Businesses and Self-employed'.

General category for employers who are liable for a contribution for their employees to the 'CPAE Social Fund' (Auxiliary Joint Committee for Employees No. 200, competent for the commercial sector) and for whom the NSSO does not collect any special contribution for a social fund for their workers (see also category 210).

General category reserved for 'non-profit' employers for whom the NSSO does not collect any special contribution for a social fund and who do not fall into any other specific category; category reserved for employers who fall mainly under PC No. 335 and who do not fall into any other specific category (see also category 000).

Category reserved for foreign employers without a place of business in Belgium who are liable: for their employees: for a contribution to the 'CPAE Social Fund' (PC No. 200, competent for the commercial sector) and, from 01/04/2012, for workers: for a contribution to the 'Fund for the training of workers of the Joint Auxiliary Committee for Workers'.

Employers falling under the Joint Committee for the Diamond Industry and Trade No. 324 for workers and certain employees; not liable for the basic contribution to the Enterprise Closure Fund for commercial enterprise workers; for certain employees: liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee No. 200 CPAE.
Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Ports No. 301 and/or Sub-Joint Committees 301.01, 301.02, 301.03 and 301.05.
Employers, commercial or non-commercial, who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for the Hotel Industry No. 302; excluding occasional workers declared in category 317.

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee No. 143 for sea fishing - 'Zeevissersfonds'; category reserved for crew members; workers with a contract for sea fishing are to be declared in a specific way for their (fixed) wages and their work (see also categories 086, 186).

As of 01/01/2008, employers falling under Joint Committee No. 332 for 'the Francophone and Germanophone Social Assistance and Healthcare Sector' (sub-sector 332.00.10); liable for a contribution to the 'Social Fund for the child care sector'; concerns Francophone and Germanophone employers located in the Walloon or Brussels Region whose main activity is child care up to 12 years of age: child care centers, after-school care, crèches, parental crèches, care for sick children, municipal child care homes, children's homes, occasional care centers, regular flexible-hour care centers, emergency care centers, drop-in centers, farandoline, drop-in care, pre-school, approved nanny services and contracted child-minder services (see also categories 322, 722).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Construction No. 124 whose main activity consists of general structural work (see also categories 026, 044, 054).

As of 01/01/2008, employers falling under Joint Committee No. 330 for Health Establishments and Services (sub-sector 330.01.10); liable for a contribution to the 'Social Fund for private hospitals'; concerns private hospitals subject to the law of 07/08/1987 and psychiatric nursing homes (see also categories 072, 111).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Construction No. 124 whose main activity consists of general finishing work (including painting, insulation, sanitary and heating installations, wood items, prefabricated elements, glazing, carpentry...), wholesale trade in construction materials... (see also categories 024, 044, 054).

Employers falling under the Sub-Joint Committee for Forestry Operations (SCP No. 125.01) who are liable for a contribution to the Fund for the Security of Existence of Forestry Operations. (see also cat. 129, 229).

Category reserved for employers falling under PC 310 (banks) or PC 326 (gas and electricity industry) who are not liable for any special contribution to any social fund, neither for workers nor for employees.
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Master Tailors, Seamstresses and Dressmakers No. 107 (see also category 038).
Embassies and consulates liable for a contribution to the auxiliary non-profit Social Fund as of 01-04-2018.

Category reserved exclusively for certain compensation services liable for social security contributions on holiday pay that they pay, as third-party payers, on behalf of employers (other than the Security of Existence Funds and the National Annual Leave Fund for the diamond industry).

Employers who are liable, as of 01/07/2012, for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Liberal Professions No. 336; category reserved for liberal professions in the strict, non-medical sense, and beneficiaries of the redistribution of social charges, i.e. veterinarian, lawyer, architect, bailiff, chartered surveyor, auditor, accountant, associations of fact formed by these people as well as companies created in the context of the exercise of these professions (see also categories 135, 435, 735, 835).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for the Printing, Graphic Arts and Newspapers Industry No. 130.

Employers, natural persons, who employ domestic staff, who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Property Management, Real Estate Agents and Domestic Workers No. 323 (see also cat. 039 'household staff').
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Funds of the Joint Committees for the Clothing and Garment Industry No. 109 and/or No. 215 (see also category 031).

Employers, natural persons, who employ 'household staff', other than domestic workers; as of 01/01/2008, they fall under the Joint Committee for the non-profit sector No. 337 or the Joint Committee for Forestry Companies No. 146; employers who fall under Joint Committees No. 144 for agriculture and No. 145 for horticultural companies are excluded (see also cat. 094, 193 and 037).

Category reserved for auxiliary staff employed by the European Communities. Collection of social security contributions limited to those relating to pension, health and disability insurance and unemployment schemes.

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Construction No. 124 whose main activity consists of tiling, mosaic and all other wall and floor covering work (except wood), plastering and rendering work, stucco and staff work (see also categories 024, 026, 054).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Funds of the Joint Committees for the Food Industry No. 118 and/or No. 220 and who are not included in another specific category for this sector (see also categories 051, 052, 058, 258, 848).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Textile Maintenance No. 110.

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Funds of the Joint Committees for the Food Industry No. 118 and/or No. 220 - sub-sector of the vegetable industry (canned, frozen, dried, dehydrated vegetables, cleaning or preparation of fresh vegetables...) (see also categories 052, 048, 058, 258, 848).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Funds of the Joint Committees for the Food Industry No. 118 and/or No. 220 - sub-sector of the fruit industry (canned, frozen, jams, syrups...) (see also categories 051, 048, 058, 258, 848).

Employers falling under Joint Committees No. 101 - National Joint Committee for Mines and No. 205 for employees of coal mines - concerns coal mines, by-product factories, organizations dependent on mines...

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Construction No. 124 whose main activity consists of performing construction roofing work and pointing work (see also categories 024, 026, 044).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Furniture and Woodworking Industry No. 126.
Employers falling under Joint Committees No. 104 for the Steel Industry and No. 210 for employees of the steel industry.

Employers who are liable for contributions for workers to the Funds of the PC for food trade No. 119, and for employees of the PC for independent retail trade No. 201 - concerns small food retail trade employing less than 20 workers (on average during the previous calendar year) (see also category 157).

Artisanal bakery (or pastry shop): bakery (or pastry shop) that manufactures fresh products for immediate consumption with a very short shelf life and consumption lounges annexed to a pastry shop where the number of workers employed is less than 20 (expressed in full-time equivalents); liable for a contribution for workers to the 'Social and Guarantee Fund for Bakeries, Pastry Shops and annexed Consumption Lounges', and for employees to the fund of the PC for independent retail trade No. 201.
Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Guarding and/or Surveillance Services No. 317.
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for the Glass Industry No. 115.

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Education and Accommodation Establishments and Services of the Flemish Community No. 319.01; concerns employers approved and/or subsidized by the Flemish Community or the Flemish Community Commission (see also categories 162, 462).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Open-Air Kaolin and Sand Quarries in the provinces of Walloon Brabant, Hainaut, Liège, Luxembourg and Namur No. 102.05 (see also categories 463, 090, 010).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Garage Businesses No. 112 (see also category 065).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Bodywork No. 149.02 (see also category 064).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Cleaning Companies No. 121.

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Electricians: installation and distribution, No. 149.01 for workers; and for employees of the PC for independent retail trade No. 201, excluding those in category 467 (see also category 467).

Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Transport and Logistics No. 140 and who are liable for a contribution to the 'Social Fund for taxi companies and car rental services with a driver' (see also categories 083, 084, 085, 283).
Manufacture/repair of shoes, slippers, bootmakers, shoemakers - see PC employees 200.

Category reserved exclusively, as of 01/07/2007, for the declaration of paid athletes under a paid athlete employment contract provided for by the law of 24 February 1978 and professional cyclists, holders of a license issued by the Royal Belgian Cycling League ASBL, and subject to restricted social security coverage; also concerns football referees and football, basketball, volleyball and cycling coaches; in combination with another category assigned to other athletes and another category assigned to ordinary workers (see also categories 076, 262, 362).

Category reserved exclusively for the declaration of doctors subject to restricted social security coverage: 1) doctors in specialist training, to be declared by the healthcare institution where the training is followed (in combination with another category assigned to ordinary workers 025..); 2) from the 3rd quarter of 2009, doctors in general practitioner training, to be declared by the general medicine training coordination center.

Employers falling under the Sub-Joint Committee for Adapted Work Companies of the Walloon Region and the German-speaking Community No. 327.03; concerns 'Germanophone' Adapted Work Companies, category reserved for Adapted Work Companies subsidized by the Walloon Region (and recognized by AWIPH - Walloon Agency for the Integration of People with Disabilities) but not liable for a contribution to the 'Security of Existence Fund for Adapted Work Companies located in the Walloon Region and the German-speaking Community'; not liable for contributions for at-risk groups (852), temporary unemployment and older unemployed (859) (see also categories 173, 273, 373, 473).

Employers, of an exclusively non-commercial type, falling under Joint Committees No. 152 and/or 225, who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Subsidized Free Education Institutions No. 152; since 01/04/2007, concerns only non-subsidized staff employed by free establishments and boarding schools subsidized by the Flemish Community, whose registered office is located in the Flemish Region or the Brussels-Capital Region and who are registered on the Dutch-speaking social security list (as of 01/07/2012: Sub-Joint Committee No. 152.01 and/or No. 225.01); not liable for contributions for at-risk groups (852), and temporary unemployment and older unemployed (859). (see also category 174).

Category reserved exclusively, as of 01/07/2007, for the declaration of paid athletes under an employee employment contract, other than athletes declared in category 070, and subject to restricted social security coverage; employers who are liable for a contribution to the Funds of the Sub-PC of the socio-cultural sector No. 329.01 (until 30/06/2012), 329.02 or 329.03, or a contribution to the Fund of the PC No. 200; in combination with another category assigned to other athletes and another category assigned to ordinary workers (see also categories 070, 262, 362).
Employers who are liable for a contribution for workers to the Funds of the Sub-Joint Committee for the Metal Trade No. 149.04; and for employees of the PC for independent retail trade No. 201.

Employers who are liable for a contribution for workers to the Funds of the Sub-Joint Committee for Precious Metals No. 149.03; and for employees of the PC for independent retail trade No. 201 - concerns watchmaking, goldsmithing, jewelry and jewelry companies.
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Metal Recovery No. 142.01 (see also categories 082, 092, 102).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Airlines No. 315.02 (see also category 180).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Paper Recovery No. 142.03 (see also categories 079, 092, 102).

Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Transport and Logistics No. 140 and who are liable for a contribution to the 'Social Fund Transport and Logistics'; and/or who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for International Trade, Transport and Logistics Employees No. 226 - only concerns the sub-sectors of road transport of goods for third parties, handling of goods and/or logistics services for third parties regardless of the mode of transport used (outside port areas) (see also categories 068, 084, 085, 283).

Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Transport and Logistics No. 140 and who are liable for a contribution to the 'Social Fund for moving companies, furniture storage and their related activities' and/or who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for International Trade, Transport and Logistics Employees No. 226 (see also categories 068, 083, 085, 283).

Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Transport and Logistics No. 140 and who are liable for a contribution to the 'Social Fund Bus & Cars' - only concerns special bus services (specialized regular services) and coach services (occasional services) (see also categories 068, 083, 283, 084, 232, 347).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Sea Fishing No. 143 - 'Waarborg en sociaal Fonds voor de zeevisserij' ; concerns fishmongers, buyers in coastal fish halls and who employ staff in their warehouses located in or near these halls (see also category 019, 186).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Funds of the Joint Committees for the Chemical Industry No. 116 and/or No. 207 (see also category 187).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Funds of the Joint Committee for Paper and Cardboard Processing No. 136 and/or the Joint Committee for Paper and Cardboard Processing Employees No. 222 (see also category 189).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Marble Quarries and Sawmills throughout the Kingdom No. 102.08 (see also categories 063, 463, 010).

Employers who are liable for a contribution for workers to the Funds of the Joint Committee for Fuel Trade No. 127, and for employees of the PC for independent retail trade No. 201 (see also category 230).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Rag Recovery No. 142.02 (see also categories 079, 082, 102).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Agricultural and Horticultural Technical Work Companies No. 132 (see also category 193).

Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Horticultural Companies No. 145, who are liable for a contribution to the 'Social Fund for the establishment and maintenance of parks and gardens'; concerns companies whose activity consists of the establishment and maintenance of parks and gardens, excluding other horticultural companies, floriculture and the cultivation of chicory or mushrooms; also concerns 'household staff' employed by a natural person employer (see also categories 194, 294, 494, 594 and 039).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund for professional training of workers under the Joint Committee for Tourist Attractions (PC 333).

Category reserved exclusively for the declaration of temporary workers employed by licensed temporary work agencies: who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Temporary Work and Licensed Companies providing Proximity Work or Services No. 322; in combination with another category assigned to ordinary workers.

Category, and specific NSSO number 194xxxx-xx, reserved exclusively for 'third-party payers' who are liable for social security contributions on behalf of employers: reserved for Security of Existence Funds identified before 30/09/1983; in combination possibly with another category, and another NSSO number, assigned to their own workers (see also categories 199, 299, 399, 699...).

Employers who are liable: for their employees: for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Independent Retail Trade No. 201, (other than those falling under another specific category: 057, 058, 067, 077, 078, 091, 169), and who are liable for a contribution for workers: for a contribution to the 'Fund for the training of workers of the Joint Auxiliary Committee for Workers' (PC No. 100).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for the Recovery of Various Products No. 142.04 (see also categories 079, 082, 092).
Category for shipowners who employ seagoing personnel for the merchant navy (PC n° 316).
Employers falling under the Sub-Joint Committee for the Concrete Industry No. 106.02 since 01/10/2006; liable, as of 01/07/2007, for a contribution to the Social Fund of the Concrete Industry.

Category reserved exclusively for the declaration of FBI subsidized contractual workers (for whom a subsidy is granted by the Interdepartmental Budgetary Fund) employed by hospitals; always in combination with category 025 and with the same characteristics as this category.

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Property Management, Real Estate Agents and Domestic Workers No. 323; concerns employers whose activity is exclusively non-commercial: employers who manage their own association of co-owners; who manage their own real estate assets, other than co-owned assets, and as of 01/07/2008 licensed IPI real estate agents (Professional Institute of Real Estate Agents) (see also categories 037, 113).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Property Management, Real Estate Agents and Domestic Workers No. 323; concerns employers whose activity is exclusively commercial: real estate managers, licensed as real estate agents by the IPI (Professional Institute of Real Estate Agents) and, as of 01/07/2008, licensed IPI real estate agents; certain employers who manage their own real estate assets, other than co-owned assets (see also categories 037, 112).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Social Fund for the Brick Industry and who fall under the Joint Committee for the Brick Industry (PC No. 114).
Ceramic industry.

Category reserved for shipowners and crew members employed under an employment contract for the service of inland waterway vessels and who are liable for a contribution to the Fund for Rhine and Inland Navigation for their workers; for barge transport (transport of goods) and passenger transport for third parties, both in Belgium and abroad, in a 40-hour regime (22/25). See also categories 221, 421, 521, 621 and 721.

As of 01/01/2008, employers falling under Joint Committee No. 331 for the 'Vlaamse welzijns- en gezondheidssector' (Flemish welfare and health sector) (sub-sector 331.00.20); liable for a contribution to the 'Sociaal Fonds voor de Vlaamse welzijns- en gezondheidssector' (Social Fund for the Flemish welfare and health sector); concerns Dutch-speaking employers, located in the Flemish Region or the Brussels Region, whose main activity concerns: family planning center, telephone support center, social volunteer organization, anti-drug addiction service, marriage contact center, prenatal consultation center, young child consultation office, child abuse trust center, adoption service, development disorder center, disabled care consultation center, home care cooperation initiative, mental health care center, health promotion and prevention services and centers with the exception of health insurance funds (see also categories 222, 422, 522, 722, 735, 911).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Hairdressing and Beauty Care No. 314; concerns the hairdressing and beauty care sector, excluding fitness centers, bodybuilding, saunas and tanning centers (see also category 223).

Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Health Establishments and Services (PC No. 330.01.10) and contributing to the 'Social Fund for private hospitals', more specifically the Flemish categorical hospitals and psychiatric nursing homes, who also contribute to the 'Sectoraal Spaarfonds van de federale sectoren' (Sectoral Savings Fund of the federal sectors).

Employers falling under the Sub-Joint Committee for Sawmills and Related Industries (SCP No. 125.02) who are liable for a contribution to the Fund for the Security of Existence of Sawmills and Related Industries. (see also cat. 029, 129).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Insurance Companies No. 306 (see also category No. 530).

Category reserved exclusively for the declaration of FBI subsidized contractual workers (for whom a subsidy is granted by the Interdepartmental Budgetary Fund) employed by semi-public hospitals; always in combination with category 032 and with the same characteristics as this category.
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for the Tobacco Industry No. 133.

Employers, liberal professions, who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Pharmacies and Pricing Offices No. 313; concerns employers, liberal professions, who carry out their activity as a natural person or association of fact (employers from category 035), as well as companies in which one of the partners holds the title of pharmacist; beneficiaries of the redistribution of social charges (see also categories 235, 335).
General category for employers who are liable for a special contribution to the auxiliary non-profit Social Fund (PC No. 337) for workers.

Employers who are liable for a contribution for workers to the Funds of the Joint Committee for Food Trade No. 119; and for employees of the Sub-Joint Committee for Medium-Sized Food Companies No. 202.01 - concerns medium-sized food retail trade employing 20 or more workers (on average during the previous calendar year) with a maximum of 2 sales points, one at the registered office and one branch (see also category 057).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee for Education and Accommodation Establishments and Services of the French Community, the Walloon Region and the German-speaking Community No. 319.02; concerns employers approved and/or subsidized by the French Community, the Walloon Region, the German-speaking Community or the French Community Commission and those, not approved or subsidized whose main activity is carried out in Wallonia (see also categories 062, 462).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the 2nd Pillar Fund SCP 102.01 for the sectoral supplementary pension scheme for workers under the Sub-Joint Committee for Small Bluestone and Limestone Quarries in the province of Hainaut (SCP 102.01).

Employers who are liable for a contribution for workers to the Fund of the Joint Committee for the Leather and Hide and Replacement Products Industry No. 128; and for employees of the PC for independent retail trade No. 201 (see also categories 069, 369).

Employers falling under the Sub-Joint Committee for Adapted Work Companies subsidized by the French Community Commission No. 327.02; concerns employers of 'Francophone' Brussels Adapted Work Companies; liable for a contribution to the 'Security of Existence Fund for Adapted Work Companies approved by the French Community Commission'; not liable for contributions for at-risk groups (852), and temporary unemployment and older unemployed (859) (see also categories 073, 273, 373, 473).

Employers, of an exclusively non-commercial type, falling under Joint Committees No. 152 and/or 225, who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Subsidized Free Education Institutions No. 152; concerns non-subsidized staff employed, since 01/04/2007, by free establishments and boarding schools and, since 01/10/2011, by free psycho-medical-social centers and free management centers in fundamental education subsidized by the French Community or the German-speaking Community, whose registered office is located in the Walloon Region or the Brussels-Capital Region and who are registered with the NSSO on the French-speaking list (as of 01/07/2012: Sub-Joint Committee No. 152.02 and/or No. 225.02); not liable for contributions for at-risk groups (852), and temporary unemployment and older unemployed (859). (see also category 074).

Category reserved exclusively, as of 01/07/2012, for the declaration of paid athletes under an employee employment contract, other than athletes declared in category 070 and 076, and subject to restricted social security coverage; employers who are liable for a special contribution to the Fund of the Sub-Joint Committee of the socio-cultural sector of the Flemish Community No. 329.01, in combination with another category assigned to other athletes and another category assigned to ordinary workers (see also categories 070, 076, 262).

Private law employers who, in addition to workers under a private law employment contract, also employ staff under public status and who fall under the Joint Committee for Commercial Aviation No. 315; as of 21/08/2009, they fall under the Sub-Joint Committee for Airport Management No. 315.03; concerns in particular BAC S.A.-N.V. No. 1890168-18 (see also category 080).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Sea Fishing No. 143 - 'Waarborg en sociaal Fonds voor de zeevisserij' ; concerns employers whose economic activity consists of the operation and management of fish sales (see also categories 019, 086).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Funds of the Joint Committees for the Chemical Industry No. 116 and/or No. 207, but who are exempt from paying the part of the contribution intended for at-risk groups if they have themselves taken similar initiatives endorsed by a collective labour agreement (see also category 087).

Employers who are liable for contributions to the Funds of the Joint Committee for Pulp, Paper and Cardboard Production No. 129 and/or the Joint Committee for Employees of the Paper Industry No. 221 (see also category 089).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Agriculture No. 144; also concerns 'household staff' employed by a natural person employer for, for example, the maintenance of stables, horses... (see also categories 093 and 039).

Employers falling under the Joint Committee for Horticultural Companies No. 145, who are liable for a contribution to the 'Social and Guarantee Fund for Horticultural Companies'; concerns horticultural companies, excluding those whose activity consists of the establishment of parks and gardens, floriculture or certain cultivation of chicory or mushrooms (see also categories 094, 294, 494, 594).

Category, reserved exclusively for the Diamond Industry Fund (No. 1943023-48), the State Holiday Fund for the Diamond Industry (No. 1941003-94) and the Internal Compensation Fund for the diamond sector (No. 1943066-16), who are liable for social security contributions as 'third-party payers'; in combination possibly with another category, and another NSSO number, for their own staff (see also categories 099, 299, 399, 699,...).

Employers who are liable: for employees: for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for International Trade, Transport and Logistics Employees No. 226; and as of 01/04/2012, for workers: for a contribution to the 'Fund for the training of workers of the Joint Auxiliary Committee for Workers' (PC No. 100) (see also categories 083, 084).
Category for shipowners who employ seagoing personnel for dredging work (PC No. 316).

General category for employers who are liable for a special contribution for workers to the 'Fund for the training of workers of the Joint Auxiliary Committee for Workers' (PC No. 100) and, for employees, for a special contribution to the 'CPAE Social Fund' (of the Auxiliary Joint Committee for Employees No. 200, competent for the commercial sector) (see also category 010).

Employers falling under the Sub-Joint Committee for Home Help and Senior Assistance Services of the Flemish Community No. 318.02; concerns services subsidized by the Flemish Community, excluding non-subsidized services; employers benefiting from the cumulative structural reduction and the social Maribel reduction (see also categories 611, 011).

Foreign employers, without a place of business in Belgium, who employ workers not bound by a Belgian employment contract but who must be subject to social security in Belgium under international regulations; not liable for the annual leave contribution; not liable for most special contributions.

Category reserved for shipowners and crew members employed under an employment contract for the service of inland waterway vessels and who are liable for a contribution to the Fund for Rhine and Inland Navigation for their workers; for canal work (loading and unloading of ships) and passenger transport for third parties, both in Belgium and abroad, in a 38-hour regime (22/25). (see also categories 121, 421, 521, 621 and 721).

As of 01/01/2008, employers falling under Joint Committee No. 332 for 'the Francophone and Germanophone Social Assistance and Healthcare Sector' (sub-sector 332.00.20); liable for a contribution to the 'Social Fund for the social assistance and healthcare sector'; concerns Francophone and Germanophone employers located in the Walloon or Brussels Region whose main activity concerns: legal aid, general social action center (Cocof approved), local health promotion center (RW approved), home care coordination center, mutual aid service, health prevention and education service, family planning center, school health and health promotion service, community health promotion service, mental health center, SOS children's team, social service, telephone support center, anti-drug addiction and substance abuse prevention service, and as of 01/05/2012, aid for detainees and/or victims, meeting places, telecare, telephone reception, debt mediation-fight against over-indebtedness, adoption organizations, mutual aid and self-help services (see also categories 122, 422, 522, 722, 735, 911).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Hairdressing and Beauty Care No. 314; only concerns the sector of fitness centers, bodybuilding, saunas and tanning centers (see also category 123).

Category reserved for temporary workers employed in the construction sector; Employers of licensed temporary work agencies, specially established for the purpose of making workers available to construction companies, who fall under the Joint Committee for Construction (PC 124) and who are engaged in general structural work (see cat 024). These employers contribute both to the Social Fund for temporary workers (see cat 097) and to the Security of Existence and Professional Training Funds for workers in the construction sector of category 024. Category to be assigned based on the activity carried out by the temporary worker at the user's location.

Category reserved for temporary workers employed in the construction sector, Employers of licensed temporary work agencies, specially established for the purpose of making workers available to construction companies, who fall under the Joint Committee for Construction (PC 124) and who are engaged in general finishing work (see cat 026). These employers contribute both to the Social Fund for temporary workers (see cat 097) and to the Security of Existence and Professional Training Funds for workers in the construction sector of category 026. Category to be assigned based on the activity carried out by the temporary worker at the user's location.

Employers falling under the Sub-Joint Committee for Wood Trade (SCP No. 125.03) who are liable for a contribution to the Fund for the Security of Existence of the Wood Trade. (see also cat. 029, 129).
Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for the Petroleum Industry and Trade No. 211 (see also categories 091).
Employers who, due to their public nature, are not liable for contributions for at-risk groups (852), and temporary unemployment and older unemployed (859) (see also categories 032, 432, 532).

Employers who are liable for a contribution to the Fund of the Joint Committee for Pharmacies and Pricing Offices No. 313; concerns employers of an exclusively commercial type, who carry out their activity in the form of a commercial company and in which none of the partners holds the title of pharmacist (employers from category 000) (see also categories 135, 335).

Category reserved for temporary workers employed in the construction sector, Employers of licensed temporary work agencies, specially established for the purpose of making workers available to construction companies, who fall under the Joint Committee for Construction (PC 124) and who are engaged in tiling, mosaic and all other wall and floor covering work (except wood), plastering and rendering work, stucco and staff work (see cat 044).
